title: 2.8.2.3 dev Minor stat bug NaN%
body:
Minor (esthetic?) bug. I'm testing DASH. Build 9de71e105 sep 26th. Did not activate a pod for 24 hours. In the AAPS stats, I see O units for bolus and basal for that day (normal) but I see NaN% for the bolus/basal ratio...

I understant n/a (not available) but NaN% doesn't talk to me.
